issues.description: ImagePreview code example has unreachable comment after return statement
issues.detail: In the Image preview section, the alternative data URI example is placed after a `return` statement, making it unreachable. While it's commented out, the structure is confusing — it implies you could uncomment both, which would be dead code. Restructure as two separate function examples or use a single if/else.

issues.description: Node retrieval example uses unnecessary generator
issues.detail: `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` is equivalent to `pipeline.nodes[0]` but harder to read and assumes ordering. For a single-node pipeline example, use `pipeline.nodes[0]` directly, or filter by name (`next(n for n in pipeline.nodes if n.name == 'train_model_node')`) to make the intent explicit.

issues.description: Mermaid/Text preview examples show bare node() calls outside a Pipeline
issues.detail: Code snippets like the `generate_mermaid_preview` and `generate_code_preview` examples end with a standalone `node(...)` call not wrapped in a Pipeline or assigned to a variable. This won't run as shown and may confuse readers who copy-paste. Wrap in `Pipeline([...])` like the basic usage example.
issues.lines: mermaid preview and text preview sections

issues.description: Double space in experimental warning text
issues.detail: The warning admonition reads `described in  [`docs/about/experimental.md`]` with two spaces between 'in' and the link. Minor typographical issue but visible in rendered output.

issues.description: Adding lowercase 'polars' to ignore.txt duplicates existing 'Polars' entry
issues.detail: `.github/styles/Kedro/ignore.txt` now contains both `Polars` and `polars`. If Vale's matching is case-insensitive (common default), the second entry is redundant. If case-sensitive, this is fine but worth a comment noting why both forms are needed.

issues.description: CustomPreview example uses ellipses that aren't valid Python
issues.detail: `"nodes": [...], "edges": [...]` uses literal ellipsis tokens which are valid Python syntactically but semantically meaningless as placeholders. Users copy-pasting will get a confusing payload. Use comments like `# list of node dicts` or omit the keys.

review.summary: Documentation-only PR adding a new section to docs/build/nodes.md describing the experimental `preview_fn` feature on TaskNodes, plus two small Vale style config tweaks. Content is thorough and clearly written, but several code examples have small issues: an unreachable return-then-comment pattern in the Image preview, bare `node()` calls outside a Pipeline, and copy-paste-unfriendly ellipses. The Vale ignore list adds a lowercase duplicate of 'Polars' that may be redundant. No correctness or security concerns since this is docs-only; main risk is users copying examples that won't run as shown.
